description: This file defines the ChronologicalEvictionStrategy class, which implements an age-based cache eviction policy for a streaming system. It manages buffers, performs purging based on message age, and reports cache metrics.

classes.name: ChronologicalEvictionStrategy
classes.description: Implements an age-based eviction strategy for cache buffers, managing purging and cache metrics.

methods.name: ReportCacheSize
methods.description: Reports the current cache size to the cache monitor.

methods.name: OnBlockAllocated
methods.description: Handles the event of a new buffer block being allocated, updating internal state and metrics.

methods.name: PerformPurge
methods.description: Performs cache purging based on current time and triggers periodic monitoring.

methods.name: ShouldPurge
methods.description: Determines whether a cached message should be purged based on age and relative age.

methods.name: PerformPurgeInternal
methods.description: Internal method that purges messages from the cache based on age criteria.

methods.name: FreePurgedBuffers
methods.description: Frees buffers associated with purged messages and updates cache metrics.

methods.name: ReportPurge
methods.description: Logs cache purge activity and metrics.
